articles.title: SLS rocket hauled back to VAB for repairs
articles.summary: A 6.6-million-pound Apollo-era crawler-transporter rolled up the ramp to pad 38B on Tuesday and was positioned directly under the 3.5-million-pound Space Launch System rocket and its 11.3-million-pound mobile launch platform.

articles.title: Valve malfunction blamed for failure of Indian satellite to raise its orbit
articles.summary:
India’s space agency says a valve failure prevented a navigation spacecraft launched more than a year ago from raising its orbit.

articles.title: NASA Study to Analyze Fermented Food Samples from Space
articles.summary: Certain nutrients critical for human health lack the shelf life needed to span multi-year missions to the Moon, Mars, and beyond.
